notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year! An official preview of Blade Souls (DLC)!
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Thank you for your continuous support and companionship with Journey to the West! In the spring of 2024, we will release the first DLC, in which you will meet the first pair of goddess heros - Blade Souls in the Divinity Realm!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2502100/Journey_to_the_West__Blade_Souls/?beta=0][b]DLC Store Page[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0c09f7c4af995150e1d09c05207b772c0cde84c6.gif[/img]

Blade Souls is the first pair of characters with a female lead role and has a dual-soul system, allowing for switching during combats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3ea36016d8243c3a7556cc0d3de58b0fe27418a4.gif[/img]

Soul System: The higher the Soul power, the less energy. The Light Soul attack cards will consume, and the more energy the skill cards will consume, but they will receive additional bonuses. The Dark Soul, on the other hand, operates oppositely, with her skill cards consuming less energy and her attack cards receiving additional bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/763b215084d998d5bcdc27c35f7e5bd824cfa842.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]

Stealding Card: Characters come equipped with theft, allowing them to steal items while inflicting damage, a win-win situation to collect all the treasures along the Journey to the West.

Stun Card: No need to rely on wetness and shock to trigger it; with the right gameplay, passing through without harm is not a problem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/884dbb962902c0f9d6541e03b0cdcf010c4175fb.gif[/img]

Lost Card: Forcibly confuses bosses/elites, no longer only effective against small fry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d00b518412630c6ae703168a80cc361253c2d42f.gif[/img]

[h2]New Builds[/h2]
[list]
[*] Combo build: Seven-comboseries, eternal life, endless flow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6594e823d1bb4f510f1396aa519e6eb2344b053b.gif[/img]

[*] Poison-Stacking build: Let's stack together (keep the spider away from me).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1bfc767c231f777de24daeb41a067d46bffee95c.gif[/img]
 
[*] Invisibility build: As long as you're invisible, you'll come with a thousand souls and spirits, along with high burst damage.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/638457ac40b834a0e3fc778d84bba27dafdbfbdc.gif[/img]
 
[*] Infinite build: Draw countless sub-decks.
[/list]

The Blade Souls will officially released after the 2024 Chinese New Year. We look forward to players developing more gameplay. See you in the new year!

Blade Souls is the first pair of characters with a female lead role and has a dual-soul system, allowing for switching during combats.

notes.title: Dev Log #085: 2023-12-20
notes.content:
Starting from December 21st, we have entered the winter promotion season, and we have some exciting discounts to offer! Welcome everyone to purchase our Game as a Christmas gift for your friends! This month, we have carried out a significant amount of material optimization, and the development of DLC is also proceeding well!

Light Blade Soul and Dark Soul will undergo transformation when using specific skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d43908a27be7eae6ef47c62f0383d6d1b82ede4b.gif[/img]

We redone the character avatars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b7370c9e3c06c55e7bd16b863763bf6d4d745615.gif[/img]

We have added residual effects to the following skills: Wukong's God of Victory, Holy Monk’s Transcendent, Swine King’s Disciplined, White Dragon’s Nirvana, and Faithful Devil’s Return to Origin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d81a7f09443ba3e33500d6925e8b3a28352676e5.gif[/img]

[h2]Other optimizations:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the explanation of Living Armor.
[*] Slightly strengthened Memory Keeper's skills.
[*] Optimized the Evil Barrier effects.
[*] A significant amount of material optimization.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where multiple layers of Magic Shield from Move Flowers and Change Woods caused the game to slow down.
[*] Fixed the issue where Guardian Sword Strike became the base effect when cast multiple times.
[*] Fixed the issue where the blood reduction effect of Bodhisattva Lin Yin did not stack.
[*] Fixed the issue where Memory Keeper’s attack with added vulnerability was not explained.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Bat's skill's flying state was not displayed in the wiki.
[*] Fixed the explanation issue for the Shadow Fairy.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #084: 2023-11-30
notes.content:
In November, we opened Trial 22 and made many optimizations and bug fixes.

DLC charactor selection: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0c09f7c4af995150e1d09c05207b772c0cde84c6.gif[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trial 21 now becomes Nightmare difficulty.
[*] Adjust the order of Trials 2 to Trial 8 to make the difficulty curve smoother.
[*] The Dark Steel Axe only needs enemies to be defeated to permanently upgrade the hand card.
[*] Add gender information to the character wiki..
[*] Enhance the Guardian Swords Strike.
[*] The Five-Color Heaven Stone only reduces 1 card reward option. Stones from the Sky.
[*] Enhance Compassion.
[*] Optimize the explanations for adding energy cards.
[*] Optimize the explanations for “A Critical Moment” and "Absolute Evasion".
[*] When multiple cards are played, the High Buddha’s Endless Universe only triggers once.
[*] Add hints for the battle of Jade Emperor and battle with The High Buddha.
[*] Enhance the hints when Divine of Justice goes berserk. 
[*] Adjust the size of the Intent UI.
[*] When there are no upgradeable cards, the upgrade of Dark Steel Axe will not trigger.
[*] In Endless Mode, Holy Monk can now meet the Jade Flute Spirit.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the cleansing spring water special effect did not follow the object.
[*] Fixed some explanation issues related to protection.
[*] Fixed the issue where Deep Insight did not inherit damage when played multiple times.
[*] Fixed the issue where killing a voodoo worm was displayed as AOE.
[*] Fixed the option prompt issue for the Altar of Wind and Rain event for White Dragon.
[*] Fixed the English explanation issue for Nine Revolutions.
[*] Fixed the explanation issue for Rodent Duchess's Thirty-Six Transformations.
[*] Fixed the issue where you could still see the floating status of plot characters after they left.
[*] Fixed the bug where invisibility and summoning animations conflicted.
[*] Fixed the issue where there was still a counterattack effect when Gold Horn died.
[*] Fixed the issue where Holy Spell could not stack.
[*] Fixed the issue where the treasure and consumable compendium would have one ineffective rarity switch after closing and reopening.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Dark Steel Axe could not correctly upgrade cards after temporarily upgrading them.
[*] Fixed the explanation issue for protection.
[*] Fixed the explanation issue for Absolute Evasion.
[*] Fixed the explanation issue for Holy Spell.
[*] Fixed the bug that affected the rarity of treasures in the reward for the Wandering Celestials.
[*] Fixed the issue where the stolen chanting state doubling continuously would cause the game to lag.
[*] Fixed the issue with abnormal counting when the turn status doubled.
[*] Fixed the text repetition issue in the Nine-Tailed Fox event.
[*] Fixed the issue of multiple chant doublings causing the game to lag.
[*] Fixed the naming issue in the Gray-White Spider skill.
[*] Fixed the problem where the damage of Sermon of Buddha's Will could not be immune.
[*] Fixed the issue where Heed did not work on the player's side.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #083: 2023-10-27
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Thank you for your support along this journey!

Starting from now, the Journey to the West weekly dev log will transition into monthly reports, as the official version has been released, and we will be focusing on the development of new DLC. Steam updates will still aim for a weekly schedule or every two weeks, and we will also provide regular progress reports on the DLC development.


[h2]Gameplay Optimization:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lv. 3 Vanquisher of Evil now gains the Hell Power ability. Add the Hell Power card to Lv. 3 Vanquisher of Evil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b3bedb64ab4226c597ef92bdae9840c0a66915d8.png[/img]

[*] Vampire's Hankerchief now increases maximum health when defeating enemies, without the need for self-attacks.
[*] Add player card plays and NPC intent records to the combat log, with highlighting.
[*] Greedy Pig trait now allows a maximum of 3/4/5 consumables per turn.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Endless Universe where the As-You-Like-It World continued to function during sleep and stun.
[*] Fixed an issue where level stars wouldn't fade out when removing cards.
[*] Fixed an issue with Nine-Petal Mace where it couldn't trigger in event battles.
[*] Fixed a bug in turn display during timed battles.
[*] Fixed an issue with Crystal Dice where it could trigger twice under certain circumstances.
[*] Corrected a typo in the explanation of Goddess of the Moon.
[*] Optimized the attack effects of Vermilion Bird.
[*] Fixed an issue with the explanation of Tang Monk's Meditation Stone.
[*] Fixed a bug in Tiger Knight where the Thirty-Six Transformations couldn't correctly increase attack power.
[*] Fixed an issue with Yang Jian where enabling it in the Pokedex had special sound effects.
[*] Fixed a bug where Spiritual Money resurrected with 100% HP.
[*] Adjusted the order of Carrot's rabbit summons to ensure that the Thief Rabbit is first.
[*] Various localization bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #082: 2023-10-20
notes.content:
This week, Firefox's new skins have been implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/237ee09c4443964b9d61fcdbbeb25f65bf6d3cef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/369e843dc7da239fe3262345863563bbcbabbb4e.gif[/img]

[h2]Major Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added prompts for using charming consumables on teammates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ea4e373f0d27fb5fe7b2b3c49a68afd2f11571d1.png[/img]

[*] The cards received from the Fate Devil’s Versatile will now go into your hand rather than the draw pile.
[*] The Scroll of Sky can now affect defenses gained from abilities, artifacts, and so on.
[*] The Enlistment Document will correctly summon all main character companions.
[*] The effect of Hellfire Scroll now can last across turns.
[*] The game will now save progress at the beginning of each chapter.
[*] Increased the likelihood of successfully identifying the True Goddess of Mercy in the True or False Goddess of Mercy event.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where flying units would temporarily disappear upon loading.
[*] Fixed a bug related to the English option in the Hundreds of Ghosts event.
[*] Addressed the issue of "Ready to Die" upgrade being ineffective.
[*] Resolved problems associated with the Infinity Compass when in possession.
[*] Fixed the bold font issue in endings.
[*] Corrected abnormalities in the Heaven Furnace's picture in wiki.
[*] Fixed a problem where the multiple guardian sword special effect was triggered by random events.
[*] Attempted to fix the issue where the White Dragon's battle ends after losing the Dragon Princess.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #081: 2023-10-13
notes.content:
The new look for Sneaky Rabbit is now implemented this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b5eccd2ca85c2c26fed9ca5fd1fa781e93de4adf.png[/img]

[h2]Major Optimizations[/h2]

[list]
[*] The special starting relic options have changed to 5 out of 1, which enhances the efficiency of starting runs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ac111216b15efe835d73fa9b078b28bc98514bae.png[/img]

[*] Faithful Devil can now summon the highest and lowest-level fairies using the number keys 1-5 and Ctrl + number keys 1-5. This makes it much more convenient.

[*] Significantly increased the trigger probability of chain events, such as True and False Goddess, the battle against Master of Shadow and Light, and more.

[*] Tempting Lute has been changed to a special starting relic, making it easier to obtain at the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/82791bf639e2ecc430b98b8026e3131ebfcd3b36.png[/img]

[*] The poet's "A War Song" can now last for multiple rounds.

[*] Small pork chop now summons 4 random mice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/43feddbf8d18b46d03f85c3c303f2fb3b64522ee.png[/img]

[*] Carrots now summon 3 rabbits and have their rarity changed to rare. No need for SL Thief Rabbits anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/21f255dc7b8dc2efef854356bf6c5b685aeda4cd.png[/img]

[*] Spider Egg now summons 3 spiders. A small enhancement, but not much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c5e57a81cef95908c5feee2b6629e4161ca669a1.png[/img]

[*] Probability adjustments have been made for late-game rarity, changing from 5:60:35 to 20:50:30, increasing the chances of obtaining key cards with common rarity in the late game, and making it easier to build an unbeatable deck!
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where card effects didn't follow the card when the screen shook.
[*] Fixed an issue with Peach Fairy where when upgrading a card to intrinsic at the start, the card wouldn't be drawn in the first round.
[*] Far Seer now works when there are changes to cards (e.g., using stomach acid).
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #078: 2023-09-21
notes.content:
Did everyone start using the Monkey King skins that were updated last week? Does it make wielding the Monkey King Bar even more powerful? [b]You can also try Journey to the West on iOS here in [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]Apple Store[/url]![/b]

This week, we continue to optimize the game, and the DLC production is also proceeding as planned! The new skins of rabbit girls are almost ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/cf87d4526b53b8e6d2a0c0e65e0fc7acd01d58aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Major Optimizations[/h2]

We've made several optimizations and adjustments to the Mighty Monkey and the Hairy Monkey:
[list]
[*] The Mighty Monkey now sports the New Monkey King skin, making it more imposing! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f4a089cee7161e88c128753a30a6903c6dd92df.png[/img]

[*] We've removed the Defensive Offence card from Mighty Monkey’s card set and improved its passive ability.
[*] The Mighty Monkey's passive ability has now changed to 2/3/4 Rupture, and made Rupture to be applied when target’s defense decreased, rather than when breaking the opponent's defense. This greatly enhances the utility of Rupture in multiple attacks, especially when combined with the Holy Monk and many companions, increasing the power of the Vermilion Bird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3cc8452c1b0dec3c29ecdc0a0986410cb9421e22.png[/img]

[*] We've slightly buffed the Hairy Monkey: the passive has been changed to 2/3/4 damage and defense, with the fixed card usage of 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/700c29655d15a684ac51a461dcb39f554535cc77.png[/img]
[/list]

We've optimized the text description for the requirements of the final chapter's storyline, changing "Good" to "Virtue" and "Evil" to "Sin" to avoid confusion with the game's good and evil states.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/86ff74ebf85700e6579baa8941d1d534883ba585.png[/img]

Regarding the game's save mechanism, now, the game will not save when leaving a location until entering the next location. This is to prevent accidental actions and offer better S/L experiences. You no longer need to worry about choosing the wrong relic or grabbing the wrong card.

Now, the Seven Treasure Tree is effective against defenses other than cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f9db184556a4d4b90f86862f6f453e9ff5743386.png[/img]

[h2]Other adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Dream-Eater’sClaw will now remember the last card played for easier selection.
[*] The Chaotic Iron Axe will prioritize upgrading cards in the deck.
[*] We've adjusted the logic for the appearance of the Reincarnation Stone, which will only appear in Chapters 1 and 2 to avoid its presence in Chapters 3 and 4 without being helpful.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Rose Golden Bell attached to already upgraded cards during combat would render the upgrade ineffective.
[*] Fixed an English text bug when Master of Heave retreated in the Tang Monk's Heavenly Palace storyline.
[*] Fixed the explanation of the evil state.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a companion resurrection failure due to Holy Monk’s  Resurrection card.
[*] Fixed an abnormality caused by choosing a relic when using the last played card.
[/list]

notes.title: DLC female protagonist settings！Dev Log #076: 2023-09-07
notes.content:
This week we continue to adjust game mechanics, optimize art and user experience, and fix bugs. The production and design of the new DLC is also proceeding in an orderly manner!

[b]You can try Journey to the West on iOS here in [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]Apple Store[/url]![/b]

[b]DLC female protagonist setting:[/b]
The new characters are a pair of twin sisters, sword spirits belonging to the same sword, one is the blade and the other is the scabbard.
The character will have the characteristics of one body and two souls, the light soul is focusing on attacking, and the shadow soul is focusing on skills.
Players can switch forms at any time during the battle to maximize output.
At present, the design of the new protagonist has been basically completed, and the logic implementation, animation, special effects, sound effects, plot, etc. are expected to be completed before the end of the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/37fc253a542bc16950d2d2baf0636d957f9c2f10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/2bc1bbe81aabf137742aef98e6a10056fb96da3e.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log #072: 2023-08-11
notes.content:
This week, we an important update to share with all of you: the release of the new skin for Wukong, originally scheduled for August 29th, may be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.A member of our extended team are unable to continue her involvement in the production of the remaining content, including the animation for the new Wukong skin. This situation has impacted the progress of the animation work. 

We are actively seeking new team members to take over this role, but due to various uncertainties, we cannot guarantee that the production will be completed on time. Throughout this process, we sincerely hope for your understanding and support!

On the other hand, we're excited to announce that the character illustrations for our three new bunny girls are now complete. Let's take a look and see how well they correspond with the current little bunnies in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/fb6fad8a36eb71995aa63c572c42cdc0b271b66a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ead036252479d1befcf1cc6bbe199a294d5505a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f1a2b16fdb72efabda77c58ec0e01e1091420f55.jpg[/img]

[h2]Adjustments and Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chain Events Enhancement: We have increased the encounter probabilities for events involving Master of Light and Shadow, The Bikku Kingdom, True and False Goddess of Mercy, and other chain events. These events are now more likely to trigger in both preceding and subsequent stages to complete the stories..
[*] Fixed the issue where Holy Monk did not receive virtue points when rescuing the King of the Women's Kingdom.
[*] Resolved the problem where NPCs under the effect of "Spirit Pact" could still use the ability when shocked.
[*] Players will now receive prompts/notifications when their turn is forcibly ended.
[*] Minions that cannot be defeated will no longer trigger the Coward effect.
[*] Fixed the problem where the Mirror of Light and Shadow drew additional cards after battles without teammates.
[*] “Steady” can now correctly trigger "Painful Shackles."
[*] Companion cards will no longer cause vows to fail.
[*] During the meditation and sermon skip in the camp, additional confirmation is no longer required.
[*] Fixed bugs related to the hidden card selection.
[/list]

We are committed to continuously improving the gaming experience. We appreciate your support and understanding. If you have any feedback or questions, please feel free to contact us!

We sincerely appreciate your support and feedback. We will continue to work hard to bring you more exciting content! This week, we continue adjusting and optimizing the game logic, fixing bugs, and working on a new skin for Wukong.

[h2]Optimizations and Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option in the graphics settings to disable the cloud transitions during night scenes to prevent eye strain from excessive brightness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/64e88755963e19f0eac5142ae7cdfaacb1f6d9cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/91c798b43b260396fb7b27de199da01bc4f6be9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/06398d6b641839837f0ab77e4f9d23fc6d610701.png[/img]

[*] Added records for the fourth chapter in the travel log.
[*] Skip confirmation is no longer required when skipping card selection during battles.
[*] Reduced the prices for demon refining in the black market and talent points.
[*] Enhanced the effect of the Debris of Buddhism Temple and gives 3 Evil during event choices.
[*] Optimized the logic for skin selection, which may revert the previously saved Wukong skin to default.
[*] Adjusted the popup height during card selection to avoid blocking the confirm button.
[*] In endless mode, prioritized granting Pearl of Aquaman, Bloody Snake Scale, and Chaos Axe to facilitate card retention and upgrades.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the energy consumption issue with the Spirit Shifting.
[*] Adjusted the timing of Time Bomb to trigger after discarding cards.

notes.title: Dev Log #069: 2023-07-21
notes.content:
Thank you all for providing various feedback! This week, we have fixed many bugs (and there are more fixes on the way!),  have made several adjustments, and further increased the rewards in the endless mode to enhance the overall experience.

Please continue to follow us on our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], and we will keep you informed of any progress!

[*] Up to 6 talent points.
[*] Up to 3 extra backpack slots.
[*] Added an 8 maximum HP reward.
[*] Added a permanent strength reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/311257b578f2c2e3208b0d42fd7be4e58270ec05.png[/img]

[*] Improved the special effects of "Fiery Strike"
[*] Optimized the explanation for "Bloody Fight" skill, making it clearer.
[*] Enhanced the probabiility for encountering Master of Light and Shadow. After completing the prerequisite events, the Master of Light and Shadow event can now occur on tiles 2-11, 12, and 13.

notes.title: #068 Additional Updates: 2023-07-11
notes.content:
We greatly appreciate everyone for providing valuable feedback and suggestions, including Heart Demon, Endless Mode, user interface, and various other aspects! Based on your feedback, we have released some additional updates today, aiming to enhance everyone's gaming experience as much as possible!

Please continue to follow us on our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], and we will keep you informed of any progress!

[h2]Main optimizations:[/h2]

[olist]
[*][b]Enhancements to the Endless Mode[/b]
After optimization, you will receive three random permanent rewards per cycle, compared to the previous one reward. Now you can progress faster, resulting in a more enjoyable gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/37dc6e86c9522fe1130acf54c2278d4619ba693d.png[/img]

[*][b]New relic 'Reincarnation Stone'[/b]

We have introduced a new relic called the 'Reincarnation Stone,' which increases the probability of triggering events in unknown locations. The priority of the Reincarnation Stone's activation is lower than that of the Money-Calling Spell, but it has the highest priority apart from that, with an event occurrence probability exceeding 90% but not reaching 100%. 

The purpose is to help you achieve certain accomplishments or trigger special chain events (such as encounters with Master of Light and Shadow, Princess Iron Fan, etc).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/93ee28d2dbc408793aa078b587d63c9ed12215c3.png[/img]

[*][b]In-combat unit size adjustment settings:[/b]
We have added the functionality to adjust the size of battle units in the settings. If you feel that the character models are too large, you can adjust the size of the characters to your liking from the settings screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/253cc636d981cce68c2f98d8e94f1cf268051958.png[/img]

[*][b]Flight-related optimizations:[/b]
Optimizations have been made to flight-related attacks, making it easier to leverage Shapeshiftings in aerial combat. This includes Harpy, Sky Diver, and others. Note that in the case of these units, the number of attacks may exceed or fall short of the intended number of attacks due to their own frontal flight status. If they don't have a frontal flight status, they will inflict the same number of attacks as the target's current intention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/13c28494488c76a7985afb7bb006c77981b20e1e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5d247cacebd21c6cb3ebea2c7c56a562cd2aa58d.png[/img]

[*][b]The Fallen Monkey General is now immune to freezing.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e773743dac0277c59a50daf4366793ba3b361275.png[/img]


[*][b]Starting adjustment for Skeleton Rosary:[/b]
With the current battlefield capacity being six, in order to prevent situations where encountering Little Thief Rabbit or Fire Spider at the beginning prevents two elements from moving the target to the back row, Skeleton Rosary has been adjusted from two elements to three elements at the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b1c8e592c74711c4c08d7161d23de0427c995253.png[/img]

[*][b]New Spirit Compendium:[/b]
We have added the Five Element Spirits of Faithful Devil to the compendium, making it easier for everyone to understand the specific roles of each fairy. Currently, the compendium displays level 3 values(mechanism remains the same from level 1 to level 3, only the values change).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6843fc1391c1be436c8f47dae9d1ea8727192bf3.png[/img]

[/olist]

[h2]Other optimizations and bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various text bugs have been fixed.
[*] Fixed a rendering bug of removed cards during battles has been fixed.
[*] Even without intent, the Trial 20 High Buddha will now trigger intent by endless universe trait.
[*] The issue of map prompts obstructing mouse clicks has been resolved.
[*] The Bone Pile now does not protect Princess Jade.
[*] Companions will no longer speak when disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #067: 2023-07-07
notes.content:
This is the first week since our full release! We have received a lot of support and love, as well as some constructive feedback! Thank you all for your support! If you enjoy our game, please recommend it to others! Every positive review and recommendation is a great encouragement for our small indie studio! 

Please continue to follow us on our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], and we will keep you informed of any progress!

This week, we focus on further enhancing the game experience, fixing bugs, and ensuring a stable version.

[h2]Optimizaion of The Omen[/h2]

Based on your feedback, we have made some adjustments to the mechanism of the Heart Demon. In addition to being sealed through the previous elemental sealing mechanism, the Omen can now also be defeated through direct attacks. Killing the Omen once counts as one level of sealing. It is important to note that each card used will bear the corresponding effect of the Heart Demon's layers. Additionally, the Heart Demon now recovers HP at the end of the player's turn, restoring 50% in Trials 1-19 and 100% in Trial 20.

With the introduction of the new sealing machanism, it is no longer necessary to rely solely on the elements. This aims to minimize the experience of missing turns due to a lack of required elements to seal.

Now, if elites and bosses receive high overflow single-target damage, it will display how many times you have killed the target in total. The higher the damage stack, the more satisfying it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/614316bc476499c5476c37faf92670729a637d6f.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have optimized the skill logic of Master of Thunder Tower (also known as Fa Hai). Now, when using the skill the damage will change along with the transformation of the shield, whereas previously it required the end of the turn for the damage to change based on the shield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e322e6627a55139b83f655beeb06f1378daa91c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f5d88a65a2686f6b282ed370663274e227eb0e5.png[/img]

[*] Persistent Pays Off is now Innate after upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/25d6b960b1e5bc9928dd829f67ea59037de41b74.png[/img]

[*] Optimized the description of some cards, e.g. Ready to Die, Die Together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/57bf595228ce565233bbe0749dace8b396854267.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f826a95e546ea15d71ef0603ecbc438ee6d0357a.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a delay to the battle dialogue to prevent bugs from occurring
[*] Fixed a dialogue abnormality bug caused by God of Victory
[*] Fix a bug that Transmutation would trigger Black Hurricane's rage
[*] Fix animation issue of Persistent
[*] Fix damage of Thunder Tower does not change with Block change
[*] Fix the issue that transmutation of Catfish Guardian has no effect
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #065: 2023-06-16
notes.content:
Thank you very much to the [b]177[/b] backers who supported our crowdfunding campaign! Although our crowdfunding attempt was unsuccessful, we are extremely grateful for everyone's support and companionship along the way. 

Due to limited resources, after the official release, we will revisit our development plan for additional DLCs. Please continue to follow us on our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], and we will keep you informed of any progress!

This week, we continue to make final adjustments for the official release. Based on the community’s feedback, we have made significant changes to the Mechanism of Inner Demons, primarily reducing their attack desires to alleviate the pressure in the early layers of the seal:

[list]
[*] [b]First Seal[/b]: Summon a random NPC defeated by the player in the current game for each card played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8c4f4c99e6e97b1953defb9b7ffe5fc528d397f4.png[/img]

[*] [b]Second Seal:[/b] Absorb 1 Strength and 1 Tenacity from all player characters for each card played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d39d3f697e9437190a1e2cfd0393875a89e9ce12.png[/img]

[*] [b]Third Seal:[/b] Inflict 3 Poison on the player for each card played and grant the player 1 Energy Absorption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/960f10f38d9e3d8e8421f0d3ecf34e14157a382c.png[/img]

[*] [b]Fourth Seal:[/b] Randomly add a Curse card to the player's draw pile for each card played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8a790b229b68cd30962a936411b95a23fd420562.png[/img]

[*] [b]Fifth Seal[/b]: Release an AOE attack for each card played, activating all effects from layers 1 to 4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/7f3ab8b842034d9473f4e8dab586b20e5986d44d.png[/img]
[/list]

We have also revamped the talent tree for Faithful Devil:
[list]
[*] [b]Infinite Demon Scroll Vol I: [/b]A talent tailored for Curse-oriented build. Whenever you apply 1 layer of Curse to any unit, an additional layer of Curse is applied. This helps to compensate for the slow stacking of curses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ad9f2eb910216b3819b70cad1e7287c39fd12f7b.png[/img]

[*] [b]Infinite Demon Scroll Vol II:[/b] Whenever you expend a card, it deals damage to all cursed enemies. The damage is equal to the target's curse count raised to the power of 0.7. In essence, you can trigger this effect with almost every card played, except for companions or non-expendable neutral cards. This improves the damage output for Curse-oriented build and allows for various combos with fairies (assuming the fairies have curses).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c0ce005deeb46f5f9d0528b39026c82a56d532d2.png[/img]

[*] [b]Transcendence Scroll Vol I: [/b]It partially compensates for Faithful Devil’s lack of defense when not equipped with the Primordial Golden Battle Treasure. The specific conversion ratio is the number of cards in the expenditure pile raised to the power of 0.8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/fd02d12e90c018e263f928c442674990e9a0ae0a.png[/img]

[*] [b]Transcendence Scroll Vol II:[/b] Increases the number of cards drawn per turn, further reducing the possibility of sudden defeat and providing more room for error.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/34552825bedfe0903b8696d71e452909d6474e5f.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]Other adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chaos Spell now lasts for 3 rounds, ensuring the true identity of the mole and effectively dealing with the highest-attacking enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c37e91508a8d878cc75e477a66e726fb0bceb11e.png[/img]

[*] Bottle of Light and Shadow now consume all curses in hand at the end of the round, eliminating the situation of being stuck with a hand full of curse cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/51c634e8de9a087d81d7e36ef6ab70d3e4b0fb96.png[/img]

[*] Swine King’s talent that increases HP has been modified. Volume I now increases Strength by 2, and Volume II increases Strength by 3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/379bf985faa28564d07a77c44cf0f52e45915b5e.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the layout issue with detailed status information.
[/list]

First Seal: Summon a random NPC defeated by the player in the current game for each card played.
Second Seal: Absorb 1 Strength and 1 Tenacity from all player characters for each card played.
Third Seal: Inflict 3 Poison on the player for each card played and grant the player 1 Energy Absorption.
Fourth Seal: Randomly add a Curse card to the player's draw pile for each card played.
Fifth Seal: Release an AOE attack for each card played, activating all effects from layers 1 to 4.

notes.title: Dev Log #064: 2023-06-09
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the official version of Journey to the West will be launched on [b]June 29th[/b]! In order to express our gratitude for your enthusiasm and support along the way, we have partnered with "Alina of the Arena" to offer a limited-time special bundle, presenting you with a feast of roguelike card games!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32929/Journey_to_the_West__Alina_of_the_Arena/

Our iOS version is also available on [url= https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]App Store[/url]! 

Welcome to follow our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], where we will regularly update exciting videos and the latest information! We also have a video version of the weekly report coming up.


This week, we remade the talents of Swine King, focusing on enhancing the Bleeding build and Discipline build:
[list]
[*] [b]Crimson Stike Vol I[/b]: When Zhu Bajie attacks a bleeding unit, he will apply 2 layers of bleeding counters. In other words, once the enemy is afflicted with one layer of bleeding, each of your attacks on that NPC will apply 2 stacks of bleeding. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/aa378235e536125d3ecb08c6a549f8adcfc03c06.png[/img]

[*] [b]Crimson Stike Vol II[/b]: Whenever an enemy bleeding unit takes action, and here it refers not only to attack but also includes abilities and skills, they will receive an additional instance of bleeding damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/da854f9b69a582cf59eb8f6593a34c64e4ea3243.png[/img]

[*] [b]Suntra of Ultimate Bliss Vol I[/b]: Gain 2 random Commandment cards you don't have, greatly enhancing the chance to get all 8 commandments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f3f7666169948b32308449236b4156155c7b45db.png[/img]

[*] [b]Suntra of Ultimate Bliss Vol II[/b]: Immediately acquire an upgraded Disciplined card. If you already have all 8 commandment cards, the damage will increase by 100% with this Disciplined card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3b559925dba1f613ab0e2009b7f844c2c2ae9632.png[/img]
[/list]

In addition, we made independent changes to the logic of enemy units so that the minions summoned by enemies will not have intentions immediately but only in the next round, avoiding the imbalance towards characters other than "Pokemon" Holy Monk.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix the bug that new Spirit Power talent of White Dragon will cause Spirit Power to keep increasing.
[*] Adjust character selection scene auto layout.
[*] Fix the issue that the High Buddha will cancel his power after entering combat.
[*] Fix a game stuck bug when playing projectile effects with a effect count limit.
[*] Fix a bug that after saving/loading, "Protected by Demons" card learned by the Dragon Princess loses level.
[*] Fix a bug that exceptions occur when quitting with cards flying to deck.
[*] Add 60 FPS options for medium and low graphics qualities on mobile devices.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #063: 2023-06-02
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continuous support and companionship! We are making the final sprint towards the official release at the end of June. We kindly ask for your encouragement and to recommend the game to your family and friends who enjoy gaming! Our iOS version is also available on [url= https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]App Store[/url]! 

Welcome to follow our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], where we will regularly update interesting videos and the latest information! We also have a video version of the weekly report coming up.

This week, we continued to optimize and adjust the UI and content, aiming to enhance the user experience. We improved the Holy Monk, adjusted NPCs, and fixed some bugs.

We gave the character selection interface a complete makeover to make it appear more concise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1571d6dfa7f16dae176d7ac1686279c035ecc295.png[/img]

We added an 800x600 resolution option to accommodate different configurations. Interested users can adjust it as needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/348e005d5199f86e0dcbd6e8dd03b5178bfc560d.png[/img]

We significantly changed a core mechanism, primarily enhancing the strength of capturing leader NPCs in the Tang Monk Pokémon faction. The following adjustments were made:
[list]
[*] The Fallen Monkey General’s "Retreat and Avoid" is now an AOE move.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e5252390d2b853872dfa3a6ef08b15307e66172e.png[/img]

[*] After being captured and released as teammates by the Holy Monk, some Boss NPCs will no longer use certain moves on the player's side:
[list]
[*] Spider Queen: Will no longer use Spider Descendant move.
[*]  Skeleton Queen: Will no longer use Soul Hunter move.
[*]  The Bull King: Will no longer use the Bull King's Roar intent.
[*]  The Fallen Monkey General: Will no longer use True Star-Shifting move. 
[/list]
[*] These changes make the Boss NPCs less vulnerable on the player's side. Additionally, NPCs summoned now immediately have moves, greatly increasing the strength of the “Pokémon” Holy Monk. Compared to before, when the summoned NPC had to wait for a turn to act, this improvement is substantial. However, please note that enemy summoned minions will also take action in the current round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c4a48cd4da8244147725b0e41e791c7c603aefc2.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Other optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved tutorials in the game.
[*] Increased Sand Monk's turn element limit to 49.
[*] Optimized effect loading.
[*] Adjusted the order in which Faithful Devil obtains Overload from attack cards.
[*] The Black Market Merchant will no longer give the Holy Monk Evil Barrier when leaving.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Avoid duplicated NPC with the same type when you resurrect NPCs.
[*] Fixed an issue where character toolip were obstructed in the compendium.
[*] Resolved issues with intent overlays.
[*] Corrected the error in description for Absorb Strength.
[*] Fixed the issue with the effect of Moon Chaser.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #062: 2023-05-26
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continuous support and companionship! We are making the final sprint towards the official release at the end of June. We kindly ask for your encouragement and to recommend the game to your family and friends who enjoy gaming! Our iOS version is also available on [url= https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]App Store[/url]! 

Welcome to follow our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], where we will regularly update interesting videos and the latest information! We also have a video version of the weekly report coming up.

This week we added new talents for Wite Dragon and Holy Monk, enhanced some relics and consumables, and fixed a large number of bugs.

The talent of the White Dragon has been greatly revamped, mainly strengthening the general talents of the Dragon Princess’s skills and the usage of Spirit power:
[list]
[*][b] Heavenly Tune Scripture Vol.I[/b] allows you to have more maneuvering space at the campfire, enabling you to learn new cards and upgrade without ending the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/a3f8d890825c1b73e4a7030bfc7b1a0f916ef0dc.png[/img]

[*] [b]Heavenly Tune Scripture Vol.II[/b] increases fault tolerance in battles. The cards learned by the Dragon Princess will never result in losses. It can help you quickly get started regardless of the build you use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b6b5132a7746c89ddbfed7097018d1f28cb9c7f3.png[/img]

[*] [b]Dragon Spirit Vol.I[/b] boldly increases the maximum spiritual power by 3 points. Whether it's a spiritual power build or any other build, if you don't have a good talent to choose, pick this one. It's equivalent to adding a fault tolerance of 3 points and helps you turn the tide.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5dd6f153a55ab38c9a74c5f2545c26b516f2b1fb.png[/img]

[*] [b]Dragon Spirit Vol.II [/b]provides higher benefits the higher your current spiritual power limit is. Even if you haven't increased the spiritual power limit at the campfire, when combined with both volumes, it will still give you max spiritual power of 12 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ecbcd72104f1fcb00ada9951c881176b88f027b2.png[/img]
[/list]

Holy Monk has gained new talents too, corresponding to the Sacrifice Build and Companion Build:
[list]
[*] [b]Scripture of Cruelty Vol.I [/b] increases the maximum HP of all teammates who join your battlefield by 20% in all battles. This allows for higher damage output through sacrifices. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b469baf38e7a960ddeeaa3b4a926de8e9b81bc23.png[/img]

[*] [b]Scripture of Cruelty Vol.II[/b] grants other teammates an Evil Barrier equal to 20% of their maximum HP when a teammate dies. This greatly enhances the survival ability of the Sacrificebuild. Previously, without talents, they could only rely on inflicting evil to gain Evil Barriers or other survival skills. Now, with the blessing of the new talent, their survival ability is more than enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4c97fef6bb8fff97fd3e2e3ad8387bf81e2cc21f.png[/img]

[*] [b]The Great Zen Vol.I[/b] provides the entire team with a defense equal to 4 times the number of companions at the end of each round, enhancing the survival ability of companions in the early and middle stages. Note that this only applies to companions, not to NPCs summoned through Spirit Pact or consumables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/093605c7433c7bd644184b44b1a61116c441fb35.png[/img]

[*][b]The Great Zen Vol.II[/b] reduces the energy cost of all companion cards played for the first time each round by 1. This is equivalent to automatically using a Gold Bulletin each round, so you no longer have to worry about getting stuck with companion cards or not having enough energy to play them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/bd3e93cecaa4ee147f9ed334898317d7e2741a5f.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Other Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Bronze Helmet has undergone numerical balancing. Previously, it provided 8 Block at the end of the round if there was any energy remaining. Now, it provides 6 Block at the end of the round if there is no energy remaining.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/82b26f0f35afad7649d56f9122b500eba4626e26.png[/img]

[*] The Essence of Metal has been strengthened. Previously, it provided 6 Block at the end of the round. Now, it provides 10 Block, making it more practical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0531a09b7a56cb539040436a7a11250fdaf18dcd.png[/img]

[*] In the graphics settings, an option has been added to adjust the quantity of special effects. If you feel that there are too many effects or experiencing lag, you can adjust it according to your preference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d0b3d3e998e8a1638f8c04592df46dd9f621b15f.png[/img]

[*] Status border color adjustment to improve user experience.
[*] Wukong appears as monkey king by default.  
[*] Remove some unused cards. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a freezing bug related to Spirit Caller.
[*] Fix the bug that Dragon Princess's learned card might lose Innate keyword after save/load.
[*] Fix a bug that Lady Green's Scale removes after Block breaks.
[*] Fix a plot bug when Divine of Justice survived the final combat of Heaven.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #061: 2023-05-19
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We also welcome you to follow our official [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1329102/]Bilibili channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8fX--opZqBufSyxS65lAsw]Youtube channel[/url], where we will regularly update interesting videos and the latest information! We also have a video version of the weekly report coming up.

Our iOS version is also available on [url= https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]App Store[/url]! 

This week, we made a lot of optimizations to the UI, modified Wukong's new talent, balanced the health talents of all characters, added the option to use the classic card art of Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk in the Creative Workshop, and fixed numerous bugs.

The most important adjustment this week is the rework of Wukong's talent tree, enhancing the Burning Build and Defensive Build for Wukong.
[list]
[*] Fire Storm Vol.I allows the stacking of the burning counter on the target at a faster rate, combined with the Monkey King’s Roar of the Great Sage doubling the effect, it simply melts away the enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/7773e06c6289b696d121838953c534c4a3cc605d.png[/img]

[*] Fire Storm Vol.II further intensifies the burning effect, causing the target to be ignited and simultaneously burning away one random positive status of oneself. This talent proves to be highly beneficial when facing many late-game NPCs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8b78afaf737c7044f91465d3a7633b594eadfb91.png[/img]

[*] Defensive Tactics Vol.I the tolerance of the Escaping Flow, eliminating worries about negative effects like poisoning and corrosion that cannot be defended with evasion, greatly improving survival ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3bb20328884028bd66f91e01ae13ab8a488267bb.png[/img]

[*] Defensive Tactics Vol.II significantly increases all non-attack damage, doubling the damage of techniques such as Diverting Attention, Borrowing Strength, and Striking First, making the arrival of decisive blows quicker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1f5b758a809443bd927403aeb57906e7b2f08b31.png[/img]
[/list]

In addition, both volumes of the Health Spell of all characters have been enhanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/031a9b227562c84136a3bd59a6ec79875b439252.png[/img]

You can now remove Omen curse card in the “Cleasing Spring” event in Chapter 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0c450fa8bcd4a7ff94ae7b8286e4d01e88425ce5.png[/img]

When Faithful Devil meets the Swing King NPC, his HP is 100% instead of 50%. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/9b3a9b0238bbb81f531f19a1b8600b2fd8e8ae6d.png[/img]

Added a screen shake toggle in the menu, allowing players who find the screen shake excessive to disable it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6742331c63dd7281d66a2211d285a1c2d96077c7.png[/img]

Some players gave feedback expressing their preference for the original card art. Therefore, we have added the Creative Workshop, where you can switch to the original card art of Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b42f7f6dfff81de53cdd8b78ca002967d02ccd9d.png[/img]

[h2]Other Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Q key on the keyboard can be used to activate the special ability buttons of the characters: White Dragon's spirit power, Faithful Devil’s summoning of fairies, and Swine King’s Devour.
[*] Dismiss consumable menu when using cards to avoid some UI glitches. 
[*] Add pop up text for Evil Barrier.
[*] Optimize effect for Staff of Nine Rings.
[*] Tooltips for ability button and end turn button.
[*] Add the reason why Divine of Justice cannot be targeted by single target skill when his third eye is open.
[*] Adjust hero detail page in compendium. 
[*] Remove unused cards.
[*] Optimize camera shake. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a rare bug about reincarnation elixir.
[*] Fix rendering bug of compendium cards in combat.
[*] Fixed an Android simulator bug. 
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #060: 2023-05-12
notes.content:
Journey to the West Mobile is now available on the App Store! Come and try out Wukong for free on iOS and take the Journey to the West with you wherever you go! [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journey-to-the-west-mobile/id1669592311]Download now! [/url]

This week, we made a lot of adjustments and optimizations on team combat logic and UI, made adjustments on many cards and fixed a lot of bugs. The main adjustments include:

[h2]Adjustment to the combat logic[/h2]

The team limit has been increased to 6 members. This change greatly enhances the Monkey King’s Hair team, Holy Monk’s “Pokémon” team, and Faithful Devil’s Spirit team, as well as provides more options for team building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/7e6d6862c715c55b089adf9394557515d109b34e.jpg[/img]

The number of companions recruitable at the campfire and in shops has increased to 5, offering more choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5e6502995e1455a4a442323a1b976eb4c413fea9.png[/img]

Now, it is allowed to have 2 hero companions appear simultaneously in the same team, expanding the team selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/62e45630085b9e0e937b8b96b007958ce0efc9d2.jpg[/img]

[h2]UI Optimization[/h2]
Based on everyone's feedback, we continue to adjust the battle UI and optimize the interface. We have adjusted the brightness and saturation of the battle scenes to make them appear softer overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4beba519ceef7bd2024fb20303c34fa025dc3c98.jpg[/img]

We have optimized the icons, fonts, and layout of enemy intentions, making them more concise and easy to identify.

notes.title: Join the Party with Faithful Devil!
notes.content:
It is party time! Come to meet our last member of the gang, [b]Faithful Devil[/b], and his 5 fairies! 

Faithful Devil was originally a nameless devil born in the Quick Sands River. Through fortunate coincidences, he consumed the nine reincarnations of the Buddha of Life, which granted him power. Later, he made a bet with the Holy Monk and went westward, gradually growing into a prominent figure whose fate was closely intertwined with Holy Monk, Swine King, and Wukong. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/89a8250d092c385742a1bc3b5f97d302812dc383.gif[/img]
Faithful Devil can absorb the elements into his Skeleton Rosaart and can summon five (female) fairies of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth from these absorbed elements. In addition, he is skilled at exhausting cards to control the flow of his deck, using his Soul Eater to manipulate the positioning of his enemies, and leveraging his unique "Overload" status to unleash explosive power.

In addition to releasing Faithful Devil, we have also conducted a lot of optimization work, mainly on art and UI. We have adjusted and optimized all the cards for Wukong, Holy Monk, and White Dragon, aiming to increase the differentiation between cards and better experience during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/509b54ee279c33c7ea19c404616a715b6f1fe07c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b05e928927e610a190fdea47a4b13d175809aa28.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/adc0562e0fd6aa83eac7cf5349c0d84496a5b736.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we have also adjusted the layout of the battle scenes, added background blur, and made the battlefield layout more reasonable so that players can distinguish actions and intentions more clearly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/80a027549e6764e238337f6716a825984efc9a96.jpg[/img]

Lastly, did anyone get it right in last week's guessing game? The hand gesture of the Fire Fairy is a tribute to Makima from Chainsaw Man!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3ec7f5fa5cb8e38f99a8487bff1981a2cdd17f4b.png[/img]

[h2]Other Optimizations and Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduce the strength increase requirement of little monkey to 3 for Wukong. And each time the strength increases, the requirement further reduces by 1.
[*] Add an option to allow Swine King to gain a command card in the camp of chapter 4.
[*] Increase the chance of getting a correct element in the Omen fight.
[*] Enhanced Singing Sword as it will increase the damage exponentially.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a rare case where Worm Larva does not trigger.
[*] Fix a text bug in the Abortion Spring event.
[*] Fix the issue that spirit shifting copying ice dragon card will start an exception.
[*] Fix the issue that Event UI cannot be hidden in Endless mode.
[/list]

notes.title: A Letter for 1st Anniversary! and Dev Log #052: 2023-03-17
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm Dr. Z. It has been a year since the launch of Journey to the West EA. Thank you all for your continuous support, encouragement, and urging. On this special day, I want to chat with you all about the status of the project and studio, and our plans for 2023.

Journey to the West is our first commercial product at Z Studio, which consists of only 2 people. For nearly 3.5 years now, we have been pouring our hearts and souls into this game, self-funding every step of the way. We haven't taken a salary, and have even had to spend nearly RMB 2 million on outsourcing expenses. We made plenty of mistakes along the way, especially with our lack of experience in gameplay and art, which unfortunately resulted in sales not being proportionate to our effort.

But despite all of this, we've never given up. I personally have been working 14 hours a day, 7 days a week, trying to make this game the best it can be. The journey has been tough, but there's nothing more enjoyable or fulfilling to us than developing games. And even though sales have been poor, we're not going to let that discourage us. We're determined to keep improving the game so that we can bring everyone out there a high-quality, enjoyable experience.


We plan to release the official version in May. The last character, Faithful Devil, is now available for closed beta testing, while there are still balance, bug, and art improvements needed. After that, we hope to develop three or more DLCs and adjust the development period based on funding.

Developing DLCs still requires a lot of outsourcing for art, so we plan to launch crowdfunding campaigns on both Momo and Kickstarter in May 1st, the same day the official version launches. We hope that players who are capable and enjoy the game can provide more support.

Yours,
Dr.Z

Please see our regular weekly update below:

Faithful Devil is now available for beta testing! Please switch to: [h3] “FaithfulDevil2023” [/h3]branch to play and test! Currently, Faithful Devil’s card assets, initial artifacts, and talent icons are still being designed, and some text is being localized. notes.title: Dev Log #049: 2023-02-24
notes.content:
This week, we made significant progress on the new character, Faithful Devil: implemented most card logic, combat features, effects, and storylines. Faithful Devil is a master of manipulating the card flow with exhausting cards. He can absorb five elements (metal, wood, water, fire and earth) and stored in his Skeleton Rosary. We will reveal how to use these elements next week!

notes.title: Dev Log #044: 2023-01-20
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Chinese New Year! [/h2]

This week, we added 5 brand-new side stories, adjusted and balanced 14 neutral cards, some relics, event choices, and bug fixes. 

New side stories are now available for Wukong, Holy Monk, and Swine King, and more are coming! 
The game is also on  [url=https://www.taptap.io/app/233276]Taptap International (Android)[/url] and [url=https://afdian.net/a/JTW_ZStudio]Aifadian (iOS and Android Beta testing)[/url], please pick your favorite platforms!

We added two new side stories for Wukong： 
[olist]
[*] Prison Break - this was when the Monkey King was captured and sealed in the Furnace of Heaven. The Monkey King must defeat the High Taoist God and beak the Furnace within seven turns to survive.
[*] Book of Death - In his early days as Monkey King, Wukong went to Hell and stole the Book of Death to protect his kin from death. 
[/olist]
We adjusted the initial deck, relic, and consumables for “Kill the Skeleton Queen within three turns” and “Desert Kings,” aiming for a better user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6877f866158e1f45f8ab762d4cac31c86065bde2.jpg[/img]

We added a new side story, “The Final Trial ”, for Holy Monk. 

In the novel Journey to the West, the team finally arrives in Soul Mountains after finishing 80 challenges. However, to complete the journey, they now have one final trial left, making “81” challenges - the ideal number in Buddhist Mantra.

We adjusted the initial deck, relic, and consumables for “The New Story of Lady White” and “Travel with Death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/40d45e5fdf80ae84d2ccb521006cfdd0b2bf60bc.jpg[/img]

For White Dragon, we adjusted the initial deck, relic, and consumables for both “The Lantern Festival” and “Furious Dragons.”

Two new side stories for Swine King:
[olist]
[*] At the Spring of Nine Suns - in the Journey to the West, Swine King wants to join the spider sister at the Spring of Nine Suns but ends up in a fight.
[*] The Bull King Family is a story inspired by Swine King’s inspiration to seek true love. He helps Jade Princess to seek an answer from the Bull King Family.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0c2a4be4c43c52e7351aee05ba99c6fa96dadbd5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Balance and Enhancement[/h2]
We adjusted 14 neutral cards to improve the balance of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/513561d48f91b921195da10c41057e6c14182ccd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/af44e6017825693e9f4ed6ad73795a5664c2d8c9.jpg[/img]

We added an option (randomly appearing as one of four options) in the initial event - Stop 5 Cards from Appearing. Once selected, you can choose up to 5 cards from the Hero’s deck (75 possible cards that belong to this Hero) and ban them from this game. 

[b][Note: this change might cause some old saves to expire. If you wish to continue with the old save, please switch to the version on 2023-01-12 and finish the game before updating.][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8db103a14e5c7f0297879179be79b7eae780317c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Balances[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bottle of Light and Shadow does not give Apparition. 
[*] don't show the tooltip if text is empty.
[*] move dialog in combat if out of the screen.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potential bug fix when playing a card after consumable use.
[*] Fix exceptions when provoking NPC without intent. 
[*] Transmutation card will change name after copying a target. 
[/list]

notes.title: Happy New Year! Swine King is Officially Out!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy new year! Hope everyone stays warm and healthy during this cold weather! [/h3]

This week, we officially released the Swine King to the public branch! The Swine King has unique storylines with his love of life, Goddess of the Moon. Come to check out their love story and give them a happy ending (or a bad ending)! 

The game is also on  [url=https://www.taptap.io/app/233276]Taptap International (Android)[/url] and [url=https://afdian.net/a/JTW_ZStudio]Aifadian (iOS and Android Beta testing)[/url], please pick your favorite platforms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5823a538579af595cf1cf3da8154137801dd8d0a.png[/img]


Formally known as the General of Galaxy in his previous life, Swine King starts with 2 initial relics. The Bottomless Stomach also grants him special ability to devouring consumables to accumulate hunger points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8005741434786ecfbafe8df23aeaaa999b66f0f4.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*]Click on his “Stomach” next to the Energy
[*]Pick up to 5 consumables to devour
[*]Click “confirm”!
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/9f3a6293faad3e6f609a92888fd40ca40c2fc82b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/a4c2789610d091a9f80e8bc6591fb69dd863103e.jpg[/img]


Similar to other characters, Swine King has to meet certain conditions to enter the final chapter:
[list]
[*] Heaven: No condition needed
[*] Soul Mountains: Collaborate with Golden Eyebrow, Or Good, Or Evil
[*] The Plane of Eternity:Good or Evil
[/list]

Swine King also comes with 2 special companions: The Fat Pig and The Hungry Pig!
[list]
[*] Fat Pig: Available after beating Swine King Trial 0
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/bc7de10a412d83b15b53f71ffc56f5192ddac212.jpg[/img]
[*] Hungry Pig: Available after beating Swine King Trial 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f3af93b2af915e031a32df1df06f62278643cb2.jpg[/img]

Now you can build a dream team like this! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5147e0b373f71a58e3c306b3202f5a8a77a331cc.jpg[/img]

Appendix: compare conditions to enter the final chapter across heroes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6f9dde3297346f8333084c97bb9c56b0416e1049.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log #039: 2022-12-09
notes.content:
This week, we released the new character Swine King for beta testing on the pre-release branch. We have finished all card logic, key mechanisms, animations, and effects; while art assets, storylines, events & dialogs are still in progress. Please opt-in to the pre-release branch to try it out! (Please note that English localization is also work in progress).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1036a30efc8750c59b3acd88b5e9b2fe21ad1e71.gif[/img]

How to Opt-in:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8f9585994290a6a72bc5bedd8a2b310c22d25297.jpg[/img]

Also, we prioritized Holy Monk and Swine King as top choices on the character selection screen as these heroes are more friendly to players who are just getting started with the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f5d2ebed09333079afb22913cb99acb338b06a36.png[/img]


[h2]Balance and Enhancement[/h2][list]
[*]Clarify the requirement for Wukong to enter Soul Mountains.
[*]Dragon Princess will be reborn at the start of the player's turn instead of end of the player's turn.
[*]Allow Endless mode to unlock cards, consumables, relics, etc. 
[*]Monkey Kings Roar will double Burning even if it's not a Debuff. 
[*]Hostage does not give you a curse card before trial 17.
[*]Improve Half Moon Shovel and Dagger of Sirius.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fix a potential bug that Scarlet Bracelet will block potion use in combat after one round in endless mode. 
[*]Fix an issue that high buddha's passive good cannot be deflected. 
[*]Fix a bug that Like a Fortress cannot keep Rupture on target. 
[*]Fix a bug that Furnace of Heaven cannot correctly recognize when card type changes during play.
[/list]

Warning: Currently all balancing and bug fixing are pushed to pre-release branch, the main branch does not have these changes yet.

notes.title: Dev Log #036: 2022-11-18
notes.content:
This week, we continued making progress in designing cards and animation, implementing combat logic, and developing story plots for Swing King. We also fixed a couple of bugs, continue improving mobile UI, and improved the talent tree to be more helpful. 

The game is now on Steam, [url=https://www.taptap.io/app/233276]Taptap International (Android)[/url] and [url=https://afdian.net/a/JTW_ZStudio]Aifadian (iOS and Andriod Beta testing)[/url], please pick your favorite platforms!

[h2]Optimization[/h2][list]
[*]Add click-to-dismiss gesture on mobile after detail window or instructions are activated by long-press to optimize user experiences.
[/list]

[h2]Improve and Balancing[/h2][list]
[*]Staff of Nine Rings is now a Special relic instead of a Boss relic.
[*]Now Princess Iron Fan does not prevent certain relics or power to trigger, such as Lone Wolf's ring.
[*]Monkey King's Heart Protector makes a little Monkey protect you at end of your turn. 
[*]Now Lord of the Realm can only be triggered by an Attack card.
[*]Talent Tree enhancement: based on our community’s feedback, we enhanced the 3 universal branches of the talent tree. [list]
[*]Constitution Spell Vol 1: Apply 1 permanent constitution -> Apply 2 permanent constitution 
[*]Constitution Spell Vol 2: Apply 2 permanent constitution -> Apply 3 permanent constitution
[*]Strength Spell Vol 1: Apply 1 permanent strength -> Apply 2 permanent strength
[*]Strength Spell Vol 2: Apply 2 permanent strength -> Apply 3 permanent strength
[*]Health Spell Vol 1: Gain 10 MAX HP -> gain 15 MAX HP
[*]Health Spell Vol 1: Gain 15 MAX HP -> gain 25 MAX HP[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fix Imperial Seal of Hell popping up unwanted text. 
[*]Fix the bug that Dragon Princess failed to learn a few upgraded companion cards.
[*]Fix trial level panel order issue on-screen with a 4:3 aspect ratio. 
[*]Fix a bug of protecting a hostage when a hostage is Sleeping or Stunned.
[*]Fix a potential bug that empowers the Team cannot correctly add Strength.
[*]Fix a permanent constitution bug in the Lantern Festival event. [/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #034: 2022-11-04
notes.content:
This week, we added multiple platform data synchronization, game saves restore, adjusted some NPC skills to fit into team battles, and implemented a lot of other balances and improvements. Now we have mobile versions available on [url=https://afdian.net/a/JTW_ZStudio]Aifadian[/url]; please check it out! 

[h2]Multiple platform data synchronization[/h2]

Step 1: open “Settings” -> “Game” on one of your devices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1ebc8e1ca575bcd4d870d760ad91023baed1fdb7.png[/img]

Step 2: click the “Upload” to upload the game save, and a key will be generated and copied to clipboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e9d0d5ccb89bf9504763f07c06a5cd1f6126eee0.png[/img]

Step 3: click on “Download” and enter the key from another device (mobile or PC). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0f12a15a869a0b403eb74427ea5793c5b8daa360.png[/img]


Step 4: once the download process is completed, you can continue the game from this device with the same data as the other machine. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c3fd21fd07af13d8c88c0fd38322facca9af8cab.png[/img]

[h2]
Game save restore function[/h2]
Click on the “restore” on the same menu to restore the game file to a backup version 1 days, 3 days, or 1 week ago. This function is a good solution if your current game save is broken.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ce2904ec440f06cef6a06b1f3169e97eaedf0a99.png[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2][list]
[*]Clicking on the NPC name on the detail window can jump to the compendium page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/61f6b2ea4842bf7bf9d4def31066522079100e76.png[/img]
[*]You can use “All” button to instantly pick all card from Hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5084f196e2fd8ef32ffd0348054a72ce09a4d764.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Balance and Improve[/h2][list]
[*]Adjusted Mighty Monkey’s cards: Twist the Knife -> Defensive Offense
[*]Bloodstone can deal damage even if your HP is full.
[*]We adjusted some NPC skills to make them more useful when they are on the player's side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/aa5ce3535c664529ca59fe2fe0130b1b81d6176b.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug that Memory Keeper and Master of Thunder Tower won't drop relics in endless mode.
[*]Fixed little monkey attack delay issue during Omen fight.
[*]Fixed sprite of goat hunter.
[*]Fixed enemy of enemy and good monk companion summoning undefeated enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug that Black Market can purify NPC you didn't defeat.
[*]Fixed deadly poison incorrectly removing debuffs.
[*]Fixed damage of Ready to Die.
[*]Fixed learned Artifact spell by Dragon Princess cannot be used after reload.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #032: 2022-10-21
notes.content:
[h1]5 New Companions![/h1]

This week, we added five new companions: Hairy Monkey, Good Monk, Evil Monk, Water Dragon, and Ice Dragon! These new companions representing different builds of the existing Heroes (Wukong, Holy Monk, and White Dragon), and each comes with a set of current or extended skills inherited from the Hero. 

[i]Note that the Hero can’t hire their shadows; for example, Holy Monk can’t hire Good Monk or Evil Monk, while Wukong can’t hire Hair Monkey. 
[/i]

These new companions unlocked various new team-building strategies - come try them out! Soon, you will also be able to construct the legendary team in the Journey to the West novel! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/287a304950a3bb65bc1ff47401fe93b1b1bafef4.png[/img]


[h1]New Companion Details[/h1]

[b]Hairy Monkey[/b] 
- One of Wukong’s shadows. Hairy Monkey is good at summoning little monkeys to fight.
- Unlocks after finishing [b]Wukong’s trial 0[/b] in story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/56b76d8a3b3e3402868ac4ca4fdfea07c91e5aea.png[/img]

[b]Good Monk[/b]
- As Holy Monk’s shadow of Good, he is the protector of the team.
- Unlocks after finishing [b]Holy Monk’s trial 0[/b] in story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/39f0554c2186627c4cdfc53a14c7af93b5911e65.png[/img]

[b]Evil Monk[/b]
- Holy Monk’s shadow of Evil, can leverage Evil Barrier and Avici Hell to unleash powerful strikes.
- Unlocks after finishing [b]Holy Monk’s trial 1[/b] in story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/43ef3361c80260c0500364bf15cf011952ba46da.png[/img]

[b]Water Dragon[/b]
- White Dragon’s shadow of water, can enhance the team’s damage using water.
- Unlocks after finishing [b]White Dragon’s trial 0[/b] in story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/224f869257cff51965938d0943f73fd0380fd9b6.png[/img]

[b]Ice Dragon[/b]
- White Dragon’s shadow of ice can destroy enemies by combining freeze and hail storms.
- Unlocks after finishing [b]White Dragon’s trial 1[/b] in story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1c933e89934d02f50905d0e48309b3dfc7b7ff04.png[/img]

notes.title: Chapter 4 is now available! 10% off Special Celebration!
notes.content:
[h1]Chapter 4 is released![/h1] 

Thank you for supporting us along this difficult but fun journey, we will have a special 10% discount starting September 30th (3am PDT), 7 days only! It is a great time to buy (if you haven’t), recommend, or give our game to friends and family as a gift!

[b]*Please note that there are still some parts of dialogs and scripts needed to be translated and polished, and we are fixing these parts as soon as possible! We apologize for the inconvenience![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1449070/_/

We also released a new PV! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=1dKxFH-uLug;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Aifadian creator page is now live! [url= https://afdian.net/a/JTW_ZStudio]Come to join us and support our game![/url][/h1]

We just started to test our mobile versions in preparation for future mobile releases, and we opened up a limited number of beta testing slots. Please check out our Aifadian page to try our mobile versions!

[h1]Introduction to Chapter 4[/h1]

There are 3 challenging storylines in Chapter 4, each comes after different chapter 3 bosses. There are different plots and prerequisites to enter the final chapters for each hero, and each hero has a couple of different ends (currently we have 37 different ends).

[b]Heaven[/b] is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating Divine of Justice at the end of Chapter 3. You will face the four generals guarding the Gate of Heaven in elite combat, and later face The Jade Emperor and his powerful team in the final combat. Based on your encounter before, you might be able to collaborate with both the Divine of Justice and the Fallen Monkey General to take revenge and destroy Heaven!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/73ac9fb5bcb496ba799c159aad06a897bdb92ea8.gif[/img]

[b]Soul Mountains[/b] is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating the Fallen Phoenix at the end of Chapter 3. Based on your encounters and choices before, you will be able to collaborate with Golden Eyebrows and Fallen Phoenix, encounter the Goddess of Cruelty (Goddess of Mercy’s sister) in elite combat, confront the High Buddha, defeat the ultimate evil, and choose the true love for Holy Monk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e8ebb097731076385356839df04b0f8d0e697a15.gif[/img]

[b]The Plane of Eternity[/b] is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating the Hell Emperor at the end of Chapter 3. The Plane of Eternity is the home and prison of Omen - the immortal being formed by sins, pain, and hatred. The seal of five elements was broken and the Omen was partially released and started its bad influence on the world, creating war, chaos, and killings. You will help the Goddess of Mercy to rebuild the Five Elements Seal to seal the Omen, face your own desires and sins, and make the right decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/a1e75be3d398d351d2cb82640fee44ce4e111330.gif[/img]

[h2]Conditions to enter the final chapter[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5cf4d1c974433d4cb74421e9fa29d3a853e0f396.png[/img]

[u][b]Note：[/b][/u][list]
[*]Collaborate with Golden Eyebrow: Choose to collaborate with Golden Eyebrow in combat or in the related event
[*]Friendly to Demons: choose choice 2 in chapter 3 boss event (when the boss is Fallen Phoenix).[/list]

[h2]Moral Status: Good, Evil, or Neutral[/h2]
We added a system to count how many “Good” choices and “Evil” choices you made during your journey from chapters 1-3 and will determine the character’s Moral Status when finishing up Chapter 3:[list]
[*]Good: Good Points > Evil Points AND Good Points >=3
[*]Evil: Evil Points >= Good Points AND Evil Points >=3
[*]Neutral: not Good nor Evil[/list]
[h3]How to earn Good Points? [/h3][list]
[*]Earn 3 Good Points for each Hostage saved
[*]Earn 1 Good Point when making good choices in events or encounters (e.g. help people)[/list]
[h3]How to earn Evil Points?[/h3][list]
[*]Earn 100 Evil Points for drinking Demon Blood (special relic)
[*]Earn 1 Evil Point when making Evil choices in events or encounters (e.g. kill, rob, or steal  from innocent people)[/list]
You can check out your moral status by clicking on the profile picture of the hero, and we will add more guidance and in-game notification about good or evil choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/9262a4b3d3d4d4077fe9d7a68e13a8325da97219.png[/img]

[h1]Let's go for a new adventure! [/h1]

[h2]Introduction to the Plane of Eternity [/h2]
The Plane of Eternity is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating [b]Hell Emperor[/b] at the end of Chapter 3. The Plane of Eternity is the home and prison of Omen - the immortal being formed by all the sins, pain, hate, and other negative emotions produced by souls around the world. [b]The seal of five elements[/b] was broken and the Omen was partially released and started its negative influence on the world, creating war, chaos and killings.

In order to save the world from emerging evil, you will partner with the Goddess of Mercy to rebuild the seal of five elements to seal the Omen - however, this is not an easy task - you need to face your own desires and sins, and make the right decision.

Conditions to enter The Plane of Eternity:[list]
