notes.title: Dev Log #018: 2022-07-10
notes.content:
This week, we released Final Chapter: Heaven for Beta testing!  Please send us feedback and suggestions as we are working on polishing this storyline. 

[b]Final Chapter: Heaven Storyline is available for Beta Testing！[/b]
Make sure to switch to the “[b]pre-release- Release Candidates[/b]” branch to test (currently in Simplified & Traditional Chinese only, and we are working on the English version for plots). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8f9585994290a6a72bc5bedd8a2b310c22d25297.jpg[/img]

You will face the four generals guarding the Gate of Heaven in elite combat, and later face The Jade Emperor and his powerful team in the final combat. Based on your encounter before, you might be able to collaborate with both the Divine of Justice and Fallen Monkey General to take revenge and destroy Heaven!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/73ac9fb5bcb496ba799c159aad06a897bdb92ea8.gif[/img]

[b]Introducing new features[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Moral Status: Good, Evil, or Neutral[/b]
[list]
[*] We added a system to count how many “Good” choices and “Evil” choices you made during your journey from chapters 1-3 and will determine the character’s Moral Status when finishing up Chapter 3:
[list]
[*] Good: Good Points > Evil Points AND Good Points >=5
[*] Evil: Evil Points >= Good Points AND Evil Points >=5
[*] Neutral: not Good nor Evil[/list]
[/list]
[*] How to earn Good Points? [list]
[*] Earn 5 Good Points for each Hostage saved
[*] Earn 1 Good Point when making good choices in events or encounters (e.g. save or help people)[/list]
[*] How to earn Evil Points?[list]
[*] Earn 5 Evil Points for drinking Demon Blood (special relic)
[*] Earn 1 Evil Point when making Evil choices in events or encounters (e.g. kill, rob, or steal  from innocent people)[/list]
[*] You can check out your moral status by clicking on the profile picture of the hero, and we will add more guidance and in-game notification about good or evil choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/9262a4b3d3d4d4077fe9d7a68e13a8325da97219.png[/img]
[*] Multiple plot-based triggers: each character will trigger different plots and conditions to enter the Heaven Storyline after encountering [b]Divine of Justice[/b] at the end of Chapter 3:
[list]
[*] Wukong can enter Heaven Storyline with [b]Good [/b]or [b]Evil [/b]moral status
[*] White Dragon can enter Heaven Storyline regardless of [b]Good[/b], [b]Evil[/b], or [b]Neutral[/b]
[*] Holy Monk can enter Heaven Storyline with [b]Good [/b]or [b]Neutral [/b]moral status
[/list]
[*] Based on your moral status and previous encounters, you will learn about the final fate of heroes, key characters, and the truth about the blood comet
[/list]

[b]*Please note that we are still testing and polishing this new system, plots, and NPCs, so the conditions above are subject to change.[/b]
[h2]Bug Fixes and optimization[/h2]
[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Added warning for evil or good gain
[*] Added a few escape effects
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that Phantom Candle could not cancel chanting properly
[*] Gold Robber's Shovel gives correct relic chances in camp
[/list]
[b]Localization and text bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a description bug in Gastric Acid
[/list]
[b]Other Bug Fixes[/b]

Major updates this week are: 
[list]
[*][b]Endless Mode is out![/b]
[list]
[*] In the Endless mode, you will start your journey on the same map going through chapter 1 to 3, but very different combinations of NPCs - endless new combinations generated to meet you at different difficulty levels
[*] After each playthrough, you will randomly and permanently inherit 1 out of 5 features from the playthrough (choose to keep 1 relic, decide to keep 1 card, keep 100 gold, keep 1 talent point, keep 1 backpack slot) and continue the game from the beginning

notes.title: Dev Log #005: 2022-04-10
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for very insightful feedback! This week we made a lot of progress on game performance optimization and are on track to develop the final chapter. Major updates: 
[list]
[*]Optimize art assets and reduce the overall package size by 30% and improve loading speed
[*]Enable the functionality of skip dialogs by long pressing blank space key for better user experiences
[*]Further enhance Holy Monk’s Spirit Pack Card - now Spirit Pack can capture Bosses after upgrading twice (enhanced), and one of the talents now grants an enhanced Spirit Pack card.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #004：2022-04-03
notes.content:
This week, we added a new feature to allow Holy Monk to capture bosses. We continue enhancing Heroes, NPCs, and Companions, and improving optimization and fixing bugs.

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]

Now Holy Monk can upgrade 1 Spirit Pact card to capture Boss in the Event of “Corvus Kingdom”! Remember that you will need to get the “Gold Jade Bar” from the Dead King in a previous event “An ask from the Dead King” to enable this choice.

[*]Clean up assets and Cache relic image to reduce memory consumption
[*]Preload card and status effects for combat for better loading speed
[/list]

[*]Regret: Add “Exhaust” keyword
[/list]

[*]Yellow Phantom: Add WindShield to AI when he is a minion.
[*]Master Zenith: MAX HP: 80-80 -> 75-80
[*]Black Hurricane:[list][*]Base damage 9 -> 8[*]MAX HP: 90-100 -> 85->95[/list]
[*]Skeleton Queen: Needs only 1 soul essence to revive all bone piles
[*]Spider Queen:[list]
[*]Spider form lasts 4 turns -> 5 turns.
[*]Spider offspring count 2 -> 3 [/list]
[*]Son of Fire: [list]
[*]Max HP: 220-210 -> 220-230
[*]increase Block of Necrofire Shield [/list]

[*]Voodoo Witch: base damage 30->27

[*]Dark Unicorn:[list]
[*]Passive skill: team immune to bleeding.

[*]Soul Transfer: Energy cost 2->1
[*]Soul Absorption: absorb 6% -> 8% [/list]

[/list]

[list]
[*]Fortification scroll: now gives invincibility at start of turn
[*]Tiger Vest: now gives Block at start of turn

[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log#003: 2022-03-27
notes.content:
This week, we updated 3 new challenges, enhanced the Evil Build for Holy Monk, added “Golden Finger” after finishing chapter 1 as a reward that can help with the next run. We are also developing a points shop to facilitate additional reward and benefit that can be accumulated after each run. Stay tuned for future updates! 

Please note that this update patch includes a change on map algorithm, so loading an existing game save after updating the game will lead to an exception. 

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enhance Holy Monk Evil Build [list]
[*]Adding a new Evil Barrier system to assist evil build. The evil barrier works as an HP reduction status to block incoming HP damage. Evil barrier can be obtained by dealing HP damage to enemies with Evil status when your HP is full. Evil barrier reduces by half each turn.
[*]Adjusted a few cards of Holy Monk to associate with this new system.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/5ee695c05f9e686566ad9d6a53cc12aec0b91ffb.png[/img]
[*]Add three more challenges in challenge mode: try to beat the difficult combat with a given deck! [list]
[*]Wukong encounters the Desert Kings alone this time
[*]White Dragon helps the Emerald Dragon King and Princess avenge their family
[*]Holy Monk has to face the Emperor of Hell while surrounded by 4 Imps
[/list]
[*]Now after beating chapter 1, you will earn a Golden Finger. It will appear as one of the rewards in the initial event of the next run to help you kick start next level. ([b]Golden Finger[/b]: next 3 combats, all enemies will only have 1 HP.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e7f578f4867a6393857b8095a6274c941048a5a6.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pooling and optimize combat effects to speed up combat 
[*]Avoid duplicated effects in combat scene
[*]Visual effect memory usage optimization
[*]Sound effect memory usage optimization
[*]Other optimizations to improve performance: add more profiling info, track destroying objects, and lazy load journal data
[/list]
[h3]UI Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pooling status UI to improve combat scene
[*]White Dragon’s Guardian Swords are fixed now to enhance the visibility of each Guardian Sword.
[/list]

[h2]Balance [/h2]
[b]Game Logic[/b]
[list]
[*]Trial 1 will not reduce the number of camps.
[*]Jade Lute Spirit will not appear if the player is Holy Monk. The change is related to the final chapter of the story.
[*]Card matching game is now pseudo random.
[*]Player cannot be charmed.
[*]Black Market requires at least 400 gold to enter.
[/list]

[b]Wukong[/b]
[list]
[*]Fiery Golden Eyes: removes blind -> removes a random status from each enemy
[*]Burn the Golden Goose: converts each status count to 1 Burning ->  converts each status to 1 [*]Burning, regardless of count.
[*]Every Hair Counts: add the “Retain” keyword.
[*]Ghost Hunter gives 2 invincible if any target's intent is Attack.
[/list]

[b]White Dragon[/b]
[list]
[*]Second to None: 15 damage -> 16 damage, Energy cost 0->1
[*]Preservation: gains X Spirit Power -> gains X Spirit Power and X Blessed.
[*]Well Prepared: 50% additional damage/75% while upgraded ->75% additional damage/100% while upgraded.
[*]Dragon Rush: 9 damage to one enemy. -> 9 damage, and  additional damage to Wet/Freezing targets. 
[/list]
[b]Holy Monk[/b]
[list]
[*]Add “Evil Barrier” for Holy Monk’s evil build.
[*]Absorb Evil:: absorb HP from targets with evil -> absorb MAX HP
[*]Absorb Life: add “Exhaust” keyword, Energy cost is 1-0.
[*]Resurrect: remove “Exhaust” keyword.
[*]True Evil: add “Exhaust” keyword. Changes buffs and debuffs to evil.
[*]Upgraded Greater Good: increase Good count to 2 -> reduces energy cost by 1
[*]Good Deeds: remove “Exhaust” keyword.
[*]Swift Move: Energy cost 2->1.
[*]Ritual: Energy Cost 3->2, lose 10% HP.
[*]Double Down: Remove “Exhaust” keyword. Rare -> Uncommon.
[*]Endless suffering: damage 5xNumber of debuffs-> applies evil to evil enemies at the end of round.
[/list]
[b]Neutral Card[/b]
[list]
[*]No balance patch.
[/list]
[b]NPC[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix maximum block for Master of Thunder Tower and Rhino King.
[*]Lord of Chaos: Plane travel sends all non-player characters to another plane.
[*]Moon Rabbit Fairy drops Medicine Pestle instead of giving it directly to the player.
[/list]
[b]Companion[/b]
In general, reducing companion card count to avoid diluting the player’s deck. And adding Retain/Exhaust/Ethereal keywords to improve the usefulness of cards.
[list]
[*]FireFox:[list]
[*]Increase scratch damage.
[*]Decrease Fire Manipulation energy cost. [/list]
[*]Shadow Fairy: Increase Healing amount. 
[*]White Tiger: Remove Slash. Adjust the importance of Roar and Stomp.
[*]Azure Dragon: [list][*]Adjust the importance of Poison Knows Poison.[*]Poisoned Weapon is now Innate.[/list]

tags.feature: Adding a new Evil Barrier system to assist evil build. The evil barrier works as an HP reduction status to block incoming HP damage. Evil barrier can be obtained by dealing HP damage to enemies with Evil status when your HP is full. Evil barrier reduces by half each turn.
Add three more challenges in challenge mode: try to beat the difficult combat with a given deck!

notes.title: Dev Log #002：2022-03-22
notes.content:
This week, we opened 3 new levels of trials (17-19), added mac build, and made decent progress on optimizations, balances, and bug fixes.

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mac build is now available! 
[*]Trial 17-19 now open! We will post a separate post about detailed change log for Trial 17-19, but quick overview:
[list] 
[*]Trial 17: Normal NPCs now have more challenging behaviors
[*]Trial 18: Elites now have more challenging behaviors
[*]Trial 19: Bosses now have more challenging behaviors
[/list][/list]
[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*]Speed up asset loading, card loading, and chapter loading speed by optimizing assets size, adding image async and effects async
[*]Add safe check to improve security for game saves
[/list]
[h3]UI Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*]Add additional info for relics
[*]Add additional info for all Cards
[*]Change Chinese font to Heiti
[*]Group card by name in Journal
[*]Optimize Black Market UI
[/list]

[h2]Balance [/h2]
[b]Game Logic[/b]
[list]
[*]Explosion logic change: trigger all poison damage at once and  burning counts remain the same after explosion -> each burning count will trigger 5 poison, and the equal counts of burning will be removed after the explosion.
[list]
[*]Example 1,  apply 15 poison and 2 burning together:
[list]
[*]Before: the explosion deals  all poison damage at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. Burning counts will remain the same after the explosion.
[*]Now: 2 burnings will trigger 10 poison at once:10+9+ ….+1=55 damage , 2 burning will be removed after the explosion, and there is 5 poison left [/list]
[*]Example 2,  apply 15 poison and 5 burning together: [list]
[*]Before: the explosion deals all poison damage at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. Burning counts will remain the same after the explosion.
[*]Now: 3 burnings will trigger 15 poison at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. 3 burning will be removed after the explosion (2 burning left), and there is no poison left.[/list][/list]
[*]Base trial factor: 80% HP -> 75% HP
[*]Change choice 2 of the “Chrysanthemum Temple” event: exchange -> transform [/list]

[b]Wukong[/b]
[list]
[*]One last fight: add “Retain” keyword, Energy cost +1
[*]Harmonic Shapes: pick 1 card at hand, reduce Energy cost by 1 -> reduce Energy costs of all cards at Hand by 1 for next play
[*]Ghost Hunter: damage 15 -> 20, Energy cost 1 ->2
[*]On Thin Ice:  add “Exhaust” keyword
[*]Fiery Dance: pick any number of cards to exhaust -> exhaust all cards on hand
[*]Borrowed Worship: energy cost 0->1
[/list]
[b]White Dragon[/b]
[list]
[*]Second to None: deal damage -> deal unblockable damage.
[*]Dual Attack: add “Exhaust” keyword
[*]Dragon in the Water: add “Exhaust” keyword
[*]Turn the Tide: add “Retain” keyword
[*]Dragon Scale Armor: Energy cost 0->1, living armor cap 20->16, Gain 10 living armor -> 8 living armor. 
[/list]
[b]Holy Monk[/b]
[list]
[*]Endless Suffering: Energy cost 1->0, damage 5xNumber of debuffs -> 10 x Number of debuffs
[*]Best Practice: 2 turns -> 3 turns
[*]Greater Good: Random enemy +1 good ->AOE +1 Good
[/list]
[b]Neutral Card[/b]
[list]
[*]Kill the worm: Energy cost 4-> 3
[*]Parasite (curse card): Energy cost 2 -> 3
[*]Embroidered Shoe: Summons rats with life link -> escape from the combat for 1 round.
[*]BloodThirsty Blade: remove “Exhaust” keyword
[/list]
[b]NPC[/b]
[list]
[*]Emperor of Hell: [list]
[*]Wheel of Death: Gain 3 strength and 30 blocks whenever player shuffles cards -> Gain 3 strength and 30 blocks whenever player shuffles cards. End player’s round immediately on 3rd shuffle in a single round.
[*]Sin Mark: Now Sin Mark will reduce to half at the end of the round.[/list]
[*]Fat Rabbit: now you can steal Fat Rabbit’s Bow from Fat Rabbit
[*]Spider Queen: Queen’s Curse on 3rd round
[*]Harpy: Feather Caller now shows damage on intent
[*]Carp King: can now swallow any minion (including Elite or Boss), or normal non-minions
[*]Princess Jade: can confuse any minion (including Elite or Boss)
[*]Nine-head Phoenix: Find Strength through Pain now applies poison to all enemies
[*]Giant Bat: increase poison count by 1
[*]Voodoo Elder: Catalyst now shows damage on intent
[*]Black Hurricane: HP range 100-110 -> 90-100
[*]Son of Fire: reduce cooldown for Concentration 4 -> 3, Necrofire Storm 4-> 3
[*]Master Zenith/Werewolf: reduce HP gain for Werewolf Shape Shifting to 15 for non-wolf characters
[*]Lohans: AI adjust for both Lohans to reduce attack synchronization, thus reduce the amount of damage in single round
[/list]
[b]Companion[/b]
[list]
[*]No balance patch.
[/list]
[b]Relics[/b]
[list]
[*]Half Moon Shovel: Deal N/3 damage -> N/2 (N=number of cards in exhaust pile) 
[*]Monkey king’s belt: Deal 3 -> 6 damage to all enemies when an ally joins or leaves combat.
[*]Fortification Spell: Gain 14 blocks on second round -> gain 1 invincibility on second round
[*]Phoenix Feather Pouch: increase 3 Max HP -> 2 Max HP
[*]Tiger Hat: 4 exhaust cards -> 3 exhaust cards
[*]Silver Fox Shawl: now you can take a look at cards before exchanging it for 2 MAX HP
[/list]
[b]Consumables[/b]
[list]
[*]Water potion: 3 wet -> 5 wet
[*]Purification bottle: summons a NPC at 50% HP -> 100% HP
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]Game logic bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix Resurrection Card logic where the upgraded version did not fully recover 75% HP for resurrected [*]target. 
[*]Fix achievement bugs
[*]Fix Golden Robe logic bug

[/list]
[b]Localization and text bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix description bug of Protection and change HP

notes.title: 2022 Spring Update: Early Access is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h2]Mark your calendar! [b]Early access[/b] is coming soon on [b]March 10th[/b]![/h2]

The EA version includes 3 heroes (Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk) and 3 chapters of story mode! Stay tuned for more details! ([url=https://discord.gg/ZaSebDg]Our Discord channel[/url] and Official QQ group: 1003867153)

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Skin for Wukong: The Mighty Monkey King![/h2]

We released a new skin for Wukong, which will unlock automatically after beating trial level 0. You can also check it out in the Tutorial:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/40aeff30d8cf54b6834df35e5cbe6775891a7039.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/40aeff30d8cf54b6834df35e5cbe6775891a7039.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]New Hero: Holy Monk[/h2]

We finished the development of a new hero, Holy Monk! As the 10th reincarnation of the Buddha of Life, Holy Monk have some special abilities:
[list]
[*]capture normal or elite NPCs as his Guardians and fight for him in combat
[*]play curse cards to his advantage
[*]apply unique Debuffs [b]Good[/b] and [b]Evil[/b] to enemies and manipulate them accordingly
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f5a135064f860e11521f82b6670efbecda6fdfe1.gif[/img]

[h2]New Title Theme and New UI![/h2]
We upgraded the main title theme, redesigned the UI, and adjusted the team alignment in combat.

[b]New main title and UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/130e754146311159e427dadd660e7e39625e1337.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b8366178b96bd5ac40d46b4707161ff67b11944b.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved team alignment in combat: Before vs. After:[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4831f7dc829c7de4c1ef47a7424aaa3ccd6f845a.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4831f7dc829c7de4c1ef47a7424aaa3ccd6f845a.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
We also added a brand new Challenge Mode for each Hero. Each challenge is one combat, with special winning conditions (e.g. a given deck, rescue hostage, or protect teammates).

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f1c19668c615a4407e8b5e1df5c7d312f7c4000.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f1c19668c615a4407e8b5e1df5c7d312f7c4000.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Other enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Balanced Wukong, White Dragon, and Companion cards
[*] Balanced relics and consumables
[*] Added credit
[*] Add music and sound effects for Chapter 3
[*] Added more art assets
[*] Rich text enhancement
[*] Polished script and dialog
[*] Improved card flow animation
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[list]
[*] Preparing the early access build for release on March 10th
[*] Optimizing the card flow animation, performance (package size, loading time, etc)
[*] Developing chapter 4 and new hero
[*] Adding more content to challenge mode
[/list]

notes.title: New Hero is Here: White Dragon!
notes.content:
[h1] The Demo Version is Now Available Again! [/h1]

The new version of Divinity Chronicles: Journey to the West is ready! 

This update includes new game modes, new optional characters, and new game content. In the Demo version, you can experience the content of the trial mode and the first chapter of the story mode. [b] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZaSebDg]Discord[/url] to share game experience and apply for beta tester to test our latest build with more content[/b].

[h1] Major Updates [/h1]

[h2] New Hero: White Dragon[/h2]
White dragon is drop-dead gorgeous with its unique mechanism and gameplay. From the beginning of the journey, he goes with the soul of her sister Dragon Princess. Dragon Princess can [b] provide the white dragon with Spirit Power during the battle [/b]; [b]store and activate Guardian Sword in the battle[/b]; [b]learn the skills of other teammates through Soul Acquisition and recover Spirit Power in the camp, etc.[/b]. Please experience the game to discover more gameplay and features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/c45f9d874844f5a0c5f6504434143078d635bd52.png[/img]


[h2]New Chapter: Hindu[/h2]
The first three chapters of the game have been completed. You will encounter more challenges in a new area [b]Hindu[/b]. As the adventure progresses, you will also learn more about dark secrets of the Realm of Divinity. 

[h2]Background Music[/h2]

For a more immersed gaming experience of players, we’ve added background music for the main interface, map, battle, and other scenes to the game, making it highly entertaining. We suggest that those who want an in-depth experience should play it with headphones.

[b]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZaSebDg]Discord[/url] and play our beta build! [/b]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
At the same time, our key plans for the next phase include:
[list]
[*][b]New hero: Holy Monk[/b]
[*][b]New game mode: Endless mode[/b]
[*][b]Adjustment and optimization of card balance[/b]
[*][b]Overall optimization of game art[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: 2021 Winter Update - New Release Date
notes.content:
[h1]Announcement - Now aiming EA on Q1 2022[/h1]

We updated our early access release date to Q1 2022. Instead of the planned 2 heroes, we are going to release 3 heroes: Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk. Each hero’s story mode includes 3 chapters and 19 levels of trials. We will also release an endless game mode, in parallel with the story mode. We apologize for the inconveniences.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] and get the latest update!

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Monkey King Hair System[/h2]
We redesigned the mechanism of Monkey King Hair. Now the new hair card can summon a little monkey to fight alongside Wukong. Each little monkey has 1HP, and will attack once with 3 base damage when Wukong attacks - a nice way to leverage powers or relics that favor multiple attacks or multiple allies. 

Check out the little monkeys in real combat:
[previewyoutube=PXa_HzS5nmU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Statistics and Achievement[/h2]
Now every playthrough will be recorded and analyzed by the new statistics and achievement system. We will continue to add new achievements as more heroes and game modes are released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/fa6c28fac31d0abc28af145b2fccbd6140a59290.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d0eefefb81dc6cd12eeca7ff1c17889e1bc06798.png[/img]

[h1]Other enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Balanced Wukong cards
[*]Balanced NPCs
[*]Balanced consumables and relics
[*]Effects improvements
[*]Improved localization
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed various game breaking bugs and logic bugs


[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

The team is working hard on improving the game. Some crucial steps are:
[list]
[*]White Dragon and Holy Monk are being implemented
[*]Adding a brand new interactive tutorial mode
[*]Adding trial level 17-19
[*]Endless mode is in development
[*]Improving UI
[*]Adding more sound effects
[*]Composing music
[/list]

notes.title: JTW Fall Update
notes.content:
[b]We are honored to be on the Tencent GWB 2021 shortlist! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] to learn more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/434745ed0abdc298d1d8f0530471147dd1b769e1.png[/img]

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]Trial mode[/h2]

We have added  a trial mode on top of normal story mode. After finishing a normal game, you will be able to enter trial mode. Currently we released 16 trial levels, each adding incremental challenges to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/bf91c0857715d2977e3769b0532f46207aaa076a.png[/img]

[h2]Black market redesign[/h2]
Black Market was redesigned to include entirely new functionality and improved strategic importance during gameplay. Besides purchasing special cards, relics, and consumables, you can also purify spirits, upgrade companions, and purchase talent points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/eacf93decef2b86ff680c9e1597d1a02b43de721.png[/img]

Spirit Purification is an interesting new function. You can purify the spirit of NPCs you’ve encountered and seal it into a bottle of purification. Later you will be able to use it as a helping hand in combat. The consumable “Bottle of Purification” is not required to perform Spirit Purification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4e80716a3c0ec159ead90b6be65af8853f0addce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ed6cdc3b11096306356be719f982cee8a94f44c1.png[/img]

Upgrade Companion is moved from camp to black market.

notes.title: New Beta Testing Version Updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b8085cea15134c98bba10114fdb8ed0635f38c29.png[/img]

[h3]New beta test version available! Please update to try the latest version, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] as beta testers! [/h3]
* Please note that this beta test version is a working in progress build, with some known issues such as uncompleted localization or art assets, and some bugs. We will update the build frequently and improve the testing experience. Thank you for your patience and support!

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Bosses![/h2]
Added 2 new bosses to act 1. We now have 3 sets of bosses in total:
[list] 
[*]Skeleton Queen
[*]Gold Horn and Silver Horn Masters
[*]Spider Queen
[/list]
[previewyoutube=ZsTOxWVl0f0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Build your team![/h2]
The long journey of battling darkness and the finding truth is never a lonely one. On the contrary, the journey becomes exciting and full of surprises with teammates. A companion comes with 2-4 unique cards to add into your deck, and a unique special talent to empower the whole team.
[previewyoutube=Z6GXHmAKATQ;full][/previewyoutube]

You can recruit companions in camp or merchant locations: There are 13 available to hire at the moment. You will also have chances to meet and invite some special companions to join your team in events. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f4afb7d4a62d7332aea9b462c1f6dbc18a480465.png[/img]

[h2]Stealing[/h2]

Now you can use stealing tools (consumable) or certain neutral cards to steal from NPCs: you can get gold, special consumables, relics or cards depending on whom you are stealing from.
[previewyoutube=w6HFVLH9AKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Status combo[/h2]

Added a status combo system: Now two buffs or debuffs can react to each other and composite into a new status. For example: Burning + Poison = Explosion.
[previewyoutube=cuDTgLe4jNk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Combat dialogs[/h2]
Events and dialogs during combat are now connected. Choices in events and encounters will result in different story lines and dialogs. Moreover, boss events will reveal important information about bosses that might affect the ending.
[previewyoutube=MNZq88aFjy8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Detail window[/h2]
Right click on the hero, companions, or NPCs to get more information (including current intent, status and skill information).

[h2]Wukong card balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shapeshifting - now you can copy the enemy’s intent using a shapeshifting card and the card will return to hand. You can also discharge a copied shapeshifting card during combat so you can copy a new intent.
[*]Meditation - now Wukong can learn skills from all NPCs (if you have at least one shapeshifting cards in the deck) that have been encountered before through the “Meditation” function in Camp.
[*]Hair - most hair related cards will generate hairs based on previous used hair type.
[*]Monkey King Bar  - as the Wukong’s initial relic, the Monkey King Bar will grand an Initial card “high initiative” to change both the length and heaviness.
[*]Evasion - Nimble fighter, sacrifice Constitution for speed and damage
[/list]

[h2]NPC balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Simplified NPC's skill sets and optimized AI
[*]Each group you meet now has their specific strategy, the goal is to make each battle more challenging and fun
[/list]

[h1]Other Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added mini games in some events
[*]Event scene art for most events in act 1
[*]Effects improvement
[*]Camp, merchant, and black market now have attendants
[*]Balancing consumables and relics
[*]Map algorithm improvement
[*]UI Improvements
[*]New mouse cursor
[*]Disable reasons
[*]Card description enhancement
[*]Status and weakness clean-up
[*]Added tutorial
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

The team is working hard on building, testing and improving the game. Some upcoming key steps are:
[list]
[*]Adding the 2nd playable character
[*]Continue to polish story mode content: Wukong, consumables, relics, encounters and stories for all 3 acts
[*]Adding clear tutorials and key tips to help new players
[*]Adding talent tree
[*]More animations and effects
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support! Please join our discord channel and we will be happy to receive your feedback!
